evidence_direction_note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring). Four-arm re-measure of V3-EXQ-869's C1 (production num_cem_iterations=3) mode-content wash-out with the two new no-op-default SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX facets (H2 mode_value_weight, H3 mode_partitioned_cem). Arms: OFF (both facets off = the 869/869a/923 wash-out control), H2-only, H3-only, BOTH; same 30 seeds across arms; arms differ ONLY by the two facets. Manipulation check (facet engagement matches config): True (480/480). Readout populated: True. Per-arm across-seed mean broad-minus-tight raw_std gap (broadest predicted mode internal_planning minus tightest offline_consolidation) vs FLOOR_PRODUCTION=0.01: {'OFF': -0.003087, 'H2': -0.001618, 'H3': 0.013631, 'BOTH': 0.011117}; clears floor: {'OFF': False, 'H2': False, 'H3': True, 'BOTH': True}. interpretation.label=fix_effective::H3+BOTH is a HYPOTHESIS about the fix locus, not a verdict -- requires a confirmed /failure-autopsy adjudication before governance acts on it. BOTH evidence directions pre-registered: fix arms clearing the floor localise the wash-out to that facet (H2 value function / H3 refit breadth); NO arm clearing = the fix is insufficient at iters=3. Same DV (mean_raw_std_by_dim), modes-in-predicted-order, and floor as V3-EXQ-869/869a/923.  2026-08-16 governance (confirmed failure_autopsy_927-928-mech267-cluster_2026-08-16): SUPERSEDED by V3-EXQ-928. V3-EXQ-927 is a BURNED QUEUE ID -- ree-v3 73f07e4 renamed the single driver from 927 to 928 and only one driver exists. The two manifests are bit-identical on every numeric field; the differing substrate_hash covers only CLAUDE.md, a queue snapshot and the driver's own id strings (git diff --stat shows NO ree_core/ change), so the substrate under test was byte-identical and the identical results are the correct deterministic outcome, not a defect. Marked inactive so the indexer stops counting one measurement twice in MECH-267 population statistics.

interpretation.combination_rule: outcome = FAIL/non_contributory if the raw_std readout is unpopulated on any cell, or the manipulation check fails (a facet did not engage as configured) -- neither is informative about the fix. Else, on a valid measurement: PASS iff >=1 fix arm's across-seed mean broad-minus-tight raw_std gap clears FLOOR_PRODUCTION AND the OFF control does not (the wash-out localisation). FAIL/label=fix_insufficient if no fix arm clears; FAIL/label=control_leak if OFF also clears (premise violated). evidence_direction is always non_contributory (diagnostic): the finding is WHICH fix locus holds, not a claim-supporting or claim-weakening reading.
